# Manual GitHub setup

Remote GitHub state cannot be inferred from tracked files. Use the canonical
[repository setup guide](../docs/repository-setup.md) to configure and verify
this repository; its explanations and complete settings live there.

## Urgent checklist

- Confirm the teams and branch rules are configured.
- Confirm development and production environments have their required controls.
- Confirm the required checks match the workflow display names.
- Create or reconcile labels from `.github/labels.yml`.
- Configure the required environment and repository secrets without recording
  their values in the repository.
